text:
Nina: seeing a cluster of mTLS failures across apac and eu-west this morning, multiple services throwing handshake errors after last night's cert rotation.
Raj: which services? any commonalities?
Nina: edge-proxy-apac, s3-ingest-eu, auth-gateway-apac. logs show 
```
remote error: tls: bad certificate
peer=10.x.x.x
```
Ellen: rotator-bot reported rotations finished but with warnings. @rotator-bot paste run summary.
rotator-bot: rotation run summary: apac-edge rotated=17/18 status=partial errors=1 code=KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED; eu-west rotated=20/20 status=success.
Raj: KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED suggests the rotator couldn't unwrap private material for some keys. did any RBAC/IAM changes land?
Ellen: infra-bot shows a scoped IAM change rolled earlier: infra/PR-1477 updated rotator role to use rotator-service-v3 and removed legacy bindings in a single batch. PR notes mention EU/NA but APAC keys were not updated.
Nina: so rotator issued certs but some lacked unwrapped private keys -> mismatch between cert and key -> client rejects.
Raj: mitigation: grant kms:Decrypt to the rotator-service-v3 principal for affected APAC keys (scoped and temporary) or rollback PR. faster to patch the key policy.
Ellen: agree. I'll open a limited key policy patch and trigger a rotation retry.
rotator-bot: queued retry for apac-edge after key-policy-change event.
Ellen: applied key-policy hotfix at 01:08Z (change=kms-hotfix-171). snippet: 
```
Sid: AllowRotatorV3Decrypt
Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rotator-service-v3
Action: kms:Decrypt
Resource: arn:aws:kms:apac-1:123456:key/*
Condition: StringEquals { aws:RequestedRegion: apac-1 }
```
rotator-bot: retry result: apac-edge rotated=18/18 status=success.
Nina: handshakes recovered for auth-gateway and edge-proxy; ingest-eu unaffected. monitoring for 45m.
Raj: follow-ups: add a CI gate that validates rotator principal decrypts keys per region, update PR-1477 with exact key-policy changes, and add a runbook entry for cross-region role swaps.
Ellen: also enable an audit alert: KMS AccessDenied on Decrypt -> post to #sec-oncall and create a PagerDuty.
Nina: opened incident page INC-2026-03156 and linked logs and change-ids. closing thread unless new errors surface. :white_check_mark:
